name: Real-IAD: Real-World Multi-View Industrial Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: Large-scale, practical industrial anomaly detection dataset consisting of 150,000 high-resolution images across 30 real-world production objects captured from five synchronized camera viewpoints to simulate automated optical inspection (AOI) lines. Features diverse defect types (pits, deformation, abrasions, scratches, contamination, missing parts) with pixel-level ground truth masks, supporting unsupervised and fully unsupervised industrial anomaly detection (FUIAD).
